notes: Extends the App Builder Frame tool (shelf_type='tiles') with two deferred P3 looks: a MOSAIC tile layout (per-tile size large/small; large=full-width hero, small=2-up) + an optional COUNTDOWN TIMER (config_json.timer={ends_at,label}; frame hides when it hits zero). Founder 'pls start building' 2026-06-29. Additive: admin (brand-web sections/page.js — mosaic layout option + per-tile size toggle + timer block + mosaic preview) + mobile (TileSection.js — MosaicStyle + useCountdown + CountdownBar). Deploy = Vercel admin + follower OTA, no APK. release.released false.
